description: Pick the dbt model that answers a metric question.

cases.name: gmv_last_month
cases.query: What was Wish's total GMV last month?
cases.notes: Line/variation-grain transaction facts. fct_daily_buyer and dau_attribution are user-day rollups the catalog also maps to GMV.

cases.name: refund_amount_last_week
cases.query: What was the total refunded amount on Wish orders last week?

cases.name: active_buyers_by_lifecycle
cases.query: Show ULC active buyers per day this month, split by lifecycle stage (new / retained / reactivated).

cases.name: add_to_cart_by_page
cases.query: How many add-to-cart events happened yesterday, broken down by page?

cases.name: wishpost_monthly_profit
cases.query: What was WishPost's monthly logistics profit over the past year?

cases.name: units_sold_last_month
cases.query: How many item units did buyers purchase on Wish last month?

cases.name: orders_yesterday
cases.query: How many orders (checkouts) were placed on Wish yesterday?
cases.notes: fct_daily_buyer added in review (2026-11-18): its per-buyer-day transaction count sums to total checkouts.

cases.name: buyers_last_week
cases.query: How many distinct buyers purchased something on Wish last week?

cases.name: atv_last_month
cases.query: What was the average transaction value (GMV per order) last month?

cases.name: take_rate_quarter
cases.query: What is our take rate, platform revenue as a share of GMV, this quarter?

cases.name: platform_revenue_last_month
cases.query: How much platform revenue (raw revenue after attributed costs) did Wish make last month?

cases.name: feed_tile_ctr
cases.query: What was the click-through rate of product tiles in the feed yesterday?

cases.name: impressions_per_product
cases.query: How many impressions did each product get yesterday?

cases.name: buyer_conversion_rate
cases.query: What share of daily active users made a purchase yesterday?

cases.name: average_star_rating
cases.query: What average star rating did customers give products last week?

cases.name: low_star_rating_share
cases.query: What share of product ratings submitted last month were 1 or 2 stars?

cases.name: shipment_delivery_rate
cases.query: What share of confirmed shipments were delivered last month?

cases.name: days_to_delivery
cases.query: On average, how many days did delivered parcels take from shipment to delivery last month?

cases.name: inventory_on_hand
cases.query: How much inventory is currently on hand across all products?

cases.name: new_user_registrations
cases.query: How many new users registered each day last week?

cases.name: total_registered_users
cases.query: How many registered users does Wish have in total?

cases.name: usd_eur_exchange_rate
cases.query: What USD to EUR exchange rate should I use for last month's reporting?

cases.name: erp_api_error_rate
cases.query: What share of merchant ERP API calls returned errors yesterday?

cases.name: wishpost_logistics_sales
cases.query: What were WishPost's logistics sales (fee revenue) per month this year?

cases.name: first_mile_purchase_by_fee
cases.query: Break down WishPost's first-mile purchase costs by fee type (logistics, warehouse, hub, outbound) per month.

cases.name: last_mile_cost_per_parcel
cases.query: What is WishPost's average last-mile purchase cost per parcel?

cases.name: parcel_combine_ratio
cases.query: On average, how many pre-combination parcels are merged into one combined WishPost shipment?
cases.notes: finance_monthly_profits_1y was added in review: its avg_combination_ratio metric (pre_tracking_id_cnt / post_tracking_id_cnt) answers the question across all programs; the by_combine_ratio table covers the warehouse-combination programs only.

cases.name: refund_lag_days
cases.query: How many days on average does it take from purchase to refund completion?

cases.name: merchant_order_refund_rate
cases.query: What percentage of merchant orders were refunded last month?

cases.name: checkout_to_payment_lag
cases.query: How long does it take on average from checkout until payment is received?

cases.name: experiment_session_duration
cases.query: What is the total session duration per subject in a given A/B experiment?

cases.name: merchant_fulfillment_time
cases.query: What is the average fulfillment time across our merchants?

cases.name: merchant_ticket_response_time
cases.query: How quickly do merchants respond to customer support tickets on average?

cases.name: order_discount_amount
cases.query: How much promotional discount was given on orders last month?

cases.name: wish_cash_used
cases.query: How much Wish Cash did buyers use to pay for orders last month?

cases.name: sales_tax_charged
cases.query: How much sales tax was charged to buyers last month?

cases.name: product_boost_revenue
cases.query: How much Product Boost revenue did we earn yesterday?

cases.name: merchant_payouts
cases.query: How much did we pay out to merchants last month?

cases.name: wishpost_parcel_weight
cases.query: What was the total actual weight of WishPost first-mile parcels yesterday?

cases.name: warehouse_shipping_option_price
cases.query: What is the average listed price of warehouse shipping options by destination country?

cases.name: power_users_yesterday
cases.query: How many power users (active on 10 or more of the last 28 days) did we have yesterday?
